49. a) C. K. Sabrowsky 
c) Attorney for Community Developers, Inc.
e) Stated his client's position with respect to construction of the Airport Spur is determined by economics and is in favor of construction only if it will result in the purchase of the entire undeveloped parcels.
f) ---
g) Right of way negotiations and acquisition were stopped in March 1973 until this Final EIS is completed and approved.
The City of Milwaukee School Board has expressed interest in the undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue as compensation for the land taken from Hamlin-Garland School. This will be investigated by the Division of Highways.
50. a) James E. Sharpiro 
c) Attorney for Restaurant Associates Industries, Inc.
e) The position of his client is an urgent plea to proceed with the construction of the Airport Spur because of the economic impact they are experiencing due to the suspension of the right of way negotiation and acquisition of their property.
f) ---
g) Right of way negotiations and acquisition will not be possible until completion and acceptance of the Final EIS.
